newsitem.title: JORDAN: Seven Saudis, one Jordanian die in road crash.
newsitem.headline: Seven Saudis, one Jordanian die in road crash.

text.p: Seven Saudi nationals and one Jordanian were killed in head-on crash in eastern Jordan, the official Petra news agency reported.
Petra said the accident happened on Tuesday near the border with Iraq when a freight truck collided with a bus carrying at least 30 Saudis.
It said the Jordanian freight driver was killed and his truck burned out. Seven Saudis were killed and another 22 were wounded, Petra said.
The Jordan Times newspaper quoted a civil defence official as saying the Saudis were Shiite pilgrims travelling to holy sites in Iraq.
